requirement: Templates Management on /ops/cms: releases fold into templates like the customer card, one header press per template state with per-CMS presses on the listing strip, and Save listing never publishes

oracle.ref: PR #1137 (feat); fix evidence: 10/10/2026: one Templates Management screen replaces Quickstarts and Design inspiration; saving a card used to publish it.
oracle.invariant: The run exits 0 with 0 failures and 0 skipped tests. template-fold: a release on a shown card belongs to that card's template; tracy-base/wp7 folds into Tracy Base, tracy-apple/j6 is its own template; two releases of one CMS in a template carry their tag on the chip. template-presses: a Published template shows only Unpublish in the header, a Disabled one only Publish (off with 'Fix N issues first.' while issues remain); the listing strip shows Unpublish <CMS> when Listed, Publish <CMS> when Hidden (off with the reason the publish door would give), and an off Publish <CMS> with 'Save a listing first' when Not listed; design packs show no press. card-save-publish: Save listing calls PUT /api/ops/quickstart/inspiration only, Publish calls POST /api/ops/quickstart/inspiration/publish, and a refused press prints the server text for that release.
oracle.productSourceGap: no product file is imported, read or run through a supported form in the command's test files (see tests/qa/layers/unit/lib/sources.mjs)
